DOP: 1 udabbahi, udabbahiṃ aor. 3 sg., 1 sg. [ of *udabbahati 2 or of ubbahati 2 qv ], plucked out, rooted up; 3 sg. : M I 330, 22 (samūlaṃ bhavaṃ ~ī ti; Ps II 415, 8 : uddhari uppāṭesī ti attho); 1 sg. : Th 158 (bhave cittaṃ ~iṃ; or to ubbahati 1 ; cf Th-a II 33, 25 foll. : bhave saṃsārapaṅke nimuggaṃ ca me cittaṃ ariyamaggena hatthena uttāriṃ, nibbānathale patiṭṭhāpesin ti attho).
CPD: ud-abbahi , ° hiṃ , aor. 3 and 1 sg. ( either with augment from ubbahati [= prec. q. v. ] , or from *ud- abbahati, cf. next ) , ( he, l ) tore out, removed, eradicated; (Gotamo) sa-mūlaṃ bhavam ~ī ti, M l 330, 22 (~ uddhari uppāṭesī ti attho, Ps ll 415, 7 ); bhave cittam ~iṃ ( "l plucked out my mind [ = desire ] for existence", Norman), Th 158; (goṇo) garuṃ bhāraṃ ~i, Vin lV 5, 37* ( quoted Dhp-a lll 213, 9* and Ja l 193, 9* , tt ie latter reading udaddhari for ~i).
NCP: udabbahi 1 aor. 3 sg. plucked out, rooted up. udabbahi 2 aor. 3 sg. having gathered; having lifted up, carried; having picked out.

DOP: 3 uda n. [ S. uda-, udan] (usually only ifc and iic), water ; Ja V 6, 1* (atho bahū vanatodā nīlavārivahindharā, eds so, perhaps for toyā? 6, 20´ : bahū vanatodā tamhā tamhā vanamhā udakāni pi maṃ bahūni pavisanti, eds so ); — udasmiṃ in Ee at Ja I 296, 4 is wr for udakasmiṃ ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — ifc see nīloda; — °- kalasa , m. , a water-pot ; Ja V 94, 26 (~aṃ pūretvā, Ee so, perhaps wr; Ce udaka-; Be udakassa kalasaṃ; Se udakakalalaṃ); — °- kumbha , m. [uda + kumbha 2 ], a water-jar ; Dhp 121 (udabindunipātena ~o pi pūrati) quoted Sadd 237, 17 ; Pv 12:9 (yathā pi brahme ~o bhinno appaṭisandhiyo; ≠ Ja III 167, 8* : eds yathā pi udaka-); — °- kumbhaka , m. [uda + kumbhaka 2 ], a water-jar ; Th 431 (~am ādāya, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be udaka-); — °- gāhi(n) , mfn. , taking in water; holding water ; Ja I 5, 32* (yathā pi jajjaraṃ nāvaṃ paluggaṃ ~iniṃ sāmī chaḍḍetvā gacchanti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee udaka-) = Bv 2:23 ( Be so; Ce, Ee, Se udaka-); — °- dhi , m. , “what holds water, water-receptacle”, river; sea, ocean ; Abh 659; Vin II 203, 15* (bhesmā hi ~ī mahā) = It 86, 16* ; S I 67, 16* (samuddo ~īnaṃ seṭṭho); Vv 34:25 (appameyyo ~ī va sāgaro); Ja IV 462, 20* (~ī pi susse); V 4, 12* (~ismā); Ap 192, 17 ; Sadd 849, 3 (udakaṃ dadhāti ~i); — udadhim in Ee at Ja V 326, 29* is wr for udayam ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — °- patta , m. ( n. ) [ S. udapātra, n. ], a bowl of water ; M I 100, 15 (acche vā ~e sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se udaka-); S V 121, 27 (~o); — °- paña in Ee at S II 118, 4 is wr for udapāna qv ; — °- pāna , m.n. , a well ; Abh 677; 931; Vin II 122, 9 ; M I 39, 25* ; S II 118, 4 (kantāramagge ~o, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr udapaño); Ud 79, 5* (kiṃ kayirā ~ena āpā ce sabbadā siyuṃ); Pv 21:26; Ja V 233, 12* (~aṃ v’ anodakaṃ); Ap 188, 14 (~o kato mayā); Peṭ 171,8; Mil 66, 7 ; Vism 244, 32 ; Vv-a 46, 5 (itarāni ~āni tiṇādīhi pūretvā); — ~-dūsaka, mfn. , fouling a well ; Ja II 354, 7 (ekaṃ ~-dūsakaṃ sigālaṃ ārabbha); — ~-panālī, ~-panāḷī, f. , a channel or gutter for a well ; A IV 171, 4 ; — °- bindu , n. ( and m. ), a drop of water ; M I 78, 34 (~umhi, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se udaka-); Sn 812 (~u yathā pi pokkhare); Th 401 (~u va pokkharā); Ja V 72, 1* (~ūni); Mil 296, 16 (ekaṃ ~u); Dhp-a II 51, 9 (padumapatte patito ~u, Ee so; Ce udaka-; Be, Se patitaṃ udaka-); — ~-nipāta, m. , the falling of a drop of water ; Dhp 121; — °- bhāra in Ee at Ap 521, 7 and 521, 11 is wr for uda-hāra qv ; — °- bhārī in Ee at Ap 612, 1 is wr for udaka-hārī qv ; — °- sadda , m. , the word uda; Sadd 237, 18 (~en’ eva udakattho vutto); 237, 20 (pāḷiyaṃ kevalo ~o na diṭṭhapubbo, atthi ce suṭṭhu manasikātabbo); — °- hāra , mf (~ī). and m. , 1. ( mf. ) (one) who fetches or carries water ; Ja VI 79, 30* (~o nadiṃ gaccha, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se udaka-); Ap 317, 11 (~ā kaṭṭhahārā); 612, 1 (~ī, Be, Ce so; Se udaka-; Ee wr udabhārī; = Thī 236: eds udakahārī); — 2. ( m. ) the fetching or carrying of water ; Ap 521, 7 (~ena jīvāmi, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr udabhārena); — °- hāraka , m ( fn )., conducting water; fetching or carrying water ; Abh 510 (nettiko ~o); Ja VI 77, 5* (ko nu maṃ usunā vijjhi pamattaṃ ~aṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se udakahārikaṃ; quoted Sadd 648, 22 : udahāriyaṃ) = Cp-a 261, 26* ( Be, Se so; Ce, Ee udaka-); Ja VI 80, 4* (tesāhaṃ ~o, Ce, Ee so; Be udakāhāro; Se udakahāro; quoted Sadd 648, 23 : udaka-hāro); — °- hāriyā , ( m ) f ( n )., fetching or carrying water ; Vv 50:9 (āgañchiṃ ~ā, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se udaka-; Vv-a 212, 16 : ~ā ti udakahārikā, udakaṃ āharantī viya hutvā ti adhippāyo, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce udakahāriyā ti); — see also acchodi ( sv accha 1 ), appodavaṇṇa ( sv appa ).
CPD: uda-bindu , m. n., a drop of water; mostly in simile of waterdrop not clinging to lotus leaf: ~u yathā pi pokkhare . . . na lippati, Sn 812; sabbattha te na lippanti ~u va pokkhare, Th 665; yathā hi paduma- patte patito ~u na lippati, Dhp-a ll 51, 9 ; sokā tamhā papatanti ~u va pokkharā, Dhp 336 = Th 401; îobho pahīyate tamhā ~u va pokkharā, lt 84, 7* ; paduma-patte ~u viya sabbo soko vivaṭṭitvā gato, Ja lll 341, 5 ; paduma-palāsato ~u viya vinivaṭṭetvā, l 344, 14 ; (kileso) yathā muhuttam pi hadaye aṭhatvā padumini-pattā ~ūni viya vivaṭṭati, l 502, 10 ; telaṃ pokkhara-pattato ~u viya vivaṭṭamānaṃ agamāsi, Vism 381, 15 ; — yāva ~umhi pi me dayā paccupaṭ- ṭhitā hoti, M l 78, 34 ; yāvanto ~ūni kāyasmiṃ nipa- tiṃsu me, Ja V 72, 1* ; yathā parittaṃ ekarṙi ~u paṭhaviyaṃ nipateyya . . . , Mil 296, 16 foll.; sakala- kappaṃ deve vassante ~ūni gaṇetuṃ, Dhp-a lV 75, 10 ( v. l. udaka-b°); tatta-kapāle ~u viya sabbam uda- kaṃ susseyya, Pj ll 225, 26 ; ekam pi ~u nâtivassi, Ps lll 287, 2 ( v. l. udaka-b°); atemitu-kāmassa sarīre °-matto pi na patati, Ja l 88, 33 ; (assādo) appo °-matto hoti, Pj ll 114, 8 ( v. l. daka-bindu-); — ifc. sedô ° (Dāṭh V 33); — ° -gaṇanā , f ., the counting of water-drops; Ja V 74, 12 '; — ° -nipāta , m., the falling of water-drops; ~ena uda-kumbho pi pūrati, Dhp 121; 122 (Dhp-a lll 16, 16 ': deve vassante . . . ; 20, 16 '), quoted Sadd 237, 17 .
NCP: neuter (& m.) a drop of water.
